data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order with the right parameters (city, date as "day", traveler as "recipient"). It goes wrong in three places: the final step says to send the email when it should discard it, "{name}" in the body is not a defined parameter, and the recipient is not tied to {traveler}@example.com. These gaps make it only moderately automatable.
